task.question: Who won the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club in April 2026?
task.evidence: April 9–12: 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia – Rory McIlroy

answer: Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club in April 2026, marking his second consecutive title, finishing with a score of 276. FINAL: Rory McIlroy
